items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 15 August 2026 at 4:10pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge from the Azores High to the northwest of Scotland.


##Wind##

Mainly northwest 3 or 4, becoming variable 3 or less later in the night, settling mainly west or southwest 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair at first, scattered outbreaks of rain overnight and tomorrow morning, then becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate in places overnight & tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, imminently backing south or southwest, soon veering west or northwest on Monday morning, backing mainly southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Occasional patchy light rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
